name: Dynamic Facet Cascade
description: Provides a customizable block with AJAX dependent dropdowns to pre-filter Search API facets.
project_description: Dynamic Facet Cascade places a configurable block of cascading AJAX dropdowns in front of a Search API view page. Visitors make sequential taxonomy selections (for example Make -> Model -> Version) where each dropdown only reveals options relevant to the parent choice; on submit the block builds a Facets-compatible URL and redirects to the configured Views results page pre-filtered by the chosen values. Configuration lives in a DynamicFacetCascadePreset config entity: each preset selects a Search API-backed Views page, an ordered chain of cascade levels (each pointing to a Facets entity), and one or more tabs that each add an independent "dominant" dimension (e.g. Year). All runtime details (vocabulary, inter-level reference field, URL alias, index field) are derived from the referenced Facets entities at request time rather than stored. Each preset is exposed as its own block via a plugin deriver. An optional "cascade on existing content only" mode filters dropdown options against the live Search API index so users never see combinations that return zero results. Requires core Views plus the Search API and Facets contrib projects. This 1.0.x series is a pre-release alpha (1.0.0-alpha3).
